name: Rungta Irrigation Limited
about: Rungta Irrigation Limited engages in the design, manufacture, assemble, and market of pipe-based sprinkler irrigation systems in India. The company offers casing pipes; MDPE pipes; rigid, elastomeric, and self-fit PVC pipes; high density polyethylene (HDPE) pipes; sprinkler irrigation and drip irrigation systems; ball valves; and others. It also provides micro irrigation systems, such as online drip, inline drip, mini sprinkler, rainguns, portable sprinkler sets, and UGPL systems. In addition, the company offers micro, butterfly, superfly, screen, disc, automatic filters, flush valves, air vents, pressure release valves, control valves, pressure gauges, drip fittings, irrigation controllers, solenoid valves, and other products; and inline laterals, bends, sockets, and tee products. Further, it undertakes EPC contracts that cover engineering design, procurement, and supply of materials. The company serves agriculture, horticulture, tea, coffee, rubber, and cardamom plantation sectors. Rungta Irrigation Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
